messages:
maria_sales: FYI — Prospect flagged a few must-haves for the POC and final SOW: customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM), cross-region key mirroring (active-active), defined rotation window (no more than 24h), and SIEM-forwarded audit logs. They're also asking about pricing uplift for HSM-backed ops.
ashley_se: Got it. Do they require a specific HSM vendor attestation (e.g., FIPS 140-2/3 level) or will Redwood's HSM-backed offering suffice?
maria_sales: They mentioned FIPS 140-2 L3 and an HSM attestation report for the instance. Also they want key material never to leave their control — prefer CMKs wrapped by customer KMS.
jorge_eng: Quick technical note: our Private deployment supports customer-wrapped KEKs and can integrate CloudHSM/Thales-like HSMs. Cross-region mirroring will need our key replication bridge — it's doable but will add operational overhead.
ashley_se: Pricing question: do we bill replication traffic or charge an HSM usage premium? Sam, any thoughts on the ops cost side?
sam_ops: Replication has two parts: (1) key replication control plane messages (small), (2) HSM operations for rewrap/unwrap during sync. The major cost is HSM op counts for wrap/unwrap; we should propose an HSM ops tier or per-10k-op add-on.
ashley_se: Can we draft a quick cost delta: baseline dedicated + HSM premium + replication ops? Need to get back to customer tomorrow.
jorge_eng: For the POC we can run a non-prod with our nightly cluster + a single HSM-backed zone. That will emulate cross-region behavior but won't be true active-active. If customer insists on full active-active for POC, timeline increases by ~2 weeks.
maria_sales: They want a canary cutover during their maintenance window (Saturdays 02:00-06:00 UTC). Any SLA blockers?
on deploy-bot: new-deploy scheduled: private-kms-poc-staging -> sat 02:15 UTC
jorge_eng: That window is fine. Two caveats: (1) rotation within that window needs a dry-run to prove no failed unwraps, (2) network egress rules for HSM replication require a one-time firewall exception.
kelly_legal: Heads-up: prospect's security questionnaire requires 'custody & access' answers and an accepted KBA for key ceremony. They also want contract language stating we will not access customer key material. We'll need to draft a BYOK appendix and a KMS handling addendum.
maria_sales: Can Legal give a short checklist we can send to customer today? They want answers in the security questionnaire by EOD.
kelly_legal: I'll drop a minimal BYOK appendix and a KMS handling FAQ (what we can see, logs we store, retention, escrow rules). Expect in 2 hrs.
ashley_se: For the questionnaire items: I'll fill the technical boxes (key lifecycle, rotation, attestation, logs). Jorge — can you provide a one-paragraph on rotation rollback behavior for the doc?
jorge_eng: Sure. Suggested paragraph: "Rotation is orchestrated via customer-configured rotation policies. New KEKs are staged and tested against sample replicas. Final promotion occurs in a transactional handoff; on failure we roll back to the prior KEK and replay operations from audited logs. The system keeps unwrapping fallback paths for 24h to guarantee in-flight token handling."
sam_ops: Also add: "We can limit rotation to the maintenance window and run a simulated rotation in staging to generate a signed audit trail."
maria_sales: Customer follow-up: they asked whether Redwood will accept a vendor attestation upload to support their compliance team — e.g., HSM STIG and tamper logs. Are those available?
jorge_eng: We can provide HSM attestation and instance-specific firmware versions for managed HSMs. Tamper logs are vendor-limited; we can surface what the HSM provides but not alter vendor formats.
ashley_se: Last blocker: customer security wants an SLA for key-rotation success rate and guaranteed retention of audit logs for 13 months. Is 13 months on retention doable or do we need an add-on?
kelly_legal: 13 months is standard for enterprise; Ops — what about storage/retention?
sam_ops: We can retain logs for 13 months with the compliance retention add-on. Default is 90 days, so need to add this to the quote and SOW.
maria_sales: Action items: (1) Ashley — draft cost delta and send to customer, (2) Kelly — BYOK appendix + QA answers, (3) Jorge — provide rotation rollback blurb + attestation note, (4) Sam — confirm retention add-on pricing and HSM op cost per 10k. I'll compile and reply to customer by EOD.
ashley_se: Will do.
kelly_legal: I'll circulate the appendix shortly.
jorge_eng: Uploading rotation blurb to the shared drive (link: https://redwood.internal/drive/poc-kms-rotation)
sam_ops: Put retention pricing in the quote template under 'Compliance Add-ons' — I estimate $X/month for 13mo at our current ingest rates.
maria_sales: Thanks team — if we can get the pricing + legal note in, we should clear the customer's procurement gating questions. :thumbsup:
